continuity_scope: Witch Hat Atelier, Volume 1, Kodansha Comics English print/digital edition (208 pages; ISBN 9781632367709; published 2019-04-09). This is a narrow publisher-metadata pass for that volume only. It excludes later manga volumes, Japanese editions, anime, games, guidebooks, box sets, and other adaptations.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Penguin Random House distributor bibliographic record for Kodansha Comics edition

coverage_rule: Include only individual dramatic characters directly named and described in Kodansha's selected Volume 1 synopsis. The synopsis names and describes Coco and Qifrey; both are recorded. It does not support a broader volume cast pass.
omissions: All other Volume 1 characters, whose names or claims lack accessible claim-specific locators in the selected publisher synopsis.
Generic witches, magicians, ateliers, magic systems, places, artifacts, and themes, which remain terms/dimensions rather than character nodes.
Later-volume, anime, game, guidebook, box-set, Japanese-edition, and other adaptive material.
content_cautions: The official synopsis presents Coco as a girl pursuing magic. It does not itemize child peril, injury, body transformation, or bodily horror; this pass makes no claim about their presence or absence in the full volume.
Kodansha lists the series at rating 10+; that rating is not treated as a scene-by-scene content assessment.
uncertainties: No page or panel-level primary-text locator was accessible in the selected evidence, so this remains a deliberately narrow official-metadata pass.
The accessible Kodansha product page does not identify an individual English translator; none is inferred.
The synopsis describes Coco's aspiration and encounter with Qifrey but does not establish a formal apprenticeship, a drawing/rune mechanism, an atelier affiliation, or forbidden-memory magic.
Anime continuity is separate and unreviewed.
evidence_basis: Kodansha's official English Volume 1 product synopsis supplies the character and premise claims; Penguin Random House's distributor record supplements edition date, ISBN, and page count. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, or adaptation evidence was used.
